entry.title: [NEW] MAL-2026-18301: Malicious code in dictmerge-lite (PyPI)
entry.content:
Malicious code in dictmerge-lite (PyPI)

Affected:

  • dictmerge-lite

dictmerge-lite 1.0.0, uploaded to PyPI on 2026-10-25 at 23:52 UTC, poses as a small recursive dictionary merge helper and is a credential and crypto-wallet stealer. Importing the package runs the payload: `dictmerge_lite/__init__.py` imports `_telemetry` and starts `_telemetry.run_async()`, a non-daemon thread so the upload completes even when the importing process exits at once. `setup.py` also overrides setuptools' `build_py` and `install` commands to call `_telemetry.run()`, so builds from the source distribution can trigger it too. All errors are swallowed. `dictmerge_lite/_telemetry.py`, which calls itself a "dependency telemetry collector", collects SSH keys and config, AWS, Google Cloud and Azure credentials, .npmrc, .pypirc, .git-credentials, .gitconfig, .netrc, .pgpass, .my.cnf, …

entry.title: [UPDATED] MAL-2026-17196: Malicious code in donutpromotion (PyPI)
entry.content:
Malicious code in donutpromotion (PyPI)

Affected:

  • donutpromotion

`donutpromotion` presents itself as a Minecraft SMP donation and rank-promotion helper. The published 0.1.0 sdist instead executes an encrypted downloader before setuptools processes the package. The automated package report identified a critical `py-download-and-execute` signal at `donutpromotion/telemetry.py:99`: downloaded or embedded bytes are decrypted and passed to `exec()` with unrestricted builtins. Review of the cited path confirms the install trigger. When `setup.py` runs during build or installation, lines 6-7 import and call `donutpromotion.telemetry.check()` before `setup()` runs. `telemetry.py:19` hardcodes `https://thisisafalsepositive.st/cdn/v2/promotion/manifest.json`. The loader skips obvious staging environments and hosts without a normal user profile, accepts a direct…

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35: Brotli: Out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder ("Node2Shell") also affects the PyPI Brotli package
entry.content:
Brotli: Out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder ("Node2Shell") also affects the PyPI Brotli package

Aliases: BIT-node-2026-111497, BIT-node-min-2026-111497, CVE-2026-111497, PYSEC-2026-4322, PYSEC-2026-4323

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • brotli — fixed in 1.2.1
  • brotlicffi — fixed in 1.2.1.0

A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

entry.title: [UPDATED] PYSEC-2026-4322: Out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder ("Node2Shell") also affects the PyPI Brotli package
entry.content:
Out-of-bounds write in the Brotli decoder ("Node2Shell") also affects the PyPI Brotli package

Aliases: BIT-node-2026-111497, BIT-node-min-2026-111497, CVE-2026-111497, GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35, PYSEC-2026-4323

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • brotli — fixed in 1.2.1

CVE-2026-111497 ("Node2Shell") is an out-of-bounds write (CWE-787) in Google's Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c). DecodeBlockTypeAndLength() returns an ambiguous value for an invalid block switch, and the fast decode path discards it (CWE-252, unchecked return value), so a crafted Brotli stream makes the decoder continue on corrupted state and write past the ring buffer. Upstream rates it CVSS 4.0 9.2 and classifies the impact as potential remote code execution. The vulnerability is in Google's C library, not in Node.js specifically. The PyPI `Brotli` package is Google's CPython binding and compiles the same c/dec/decode.c that has the actual vulnerability. All `Brotli` releases up to and including 1.2.0 ship the vulnerable decoder; 1.2.1 contains the upstream fix (commit 0ed4268a) and diff…
